title: Unique affine Hom comparison extending global generators
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an affine open, A=Gamma(Y,U), and T its associated-sheaf functor transported along isoSpec [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]. Identify T(A) with the structure sheaf using tildeSelf and restrictUnitIso [lem-weil-pbc-spec-tilde-free-module]. For an A-module H and element x, let gamma_H(x):O_U->T(H) be the composite of this identification inverse with T of the linear map a |-> a*x. For a sheaf morphism phi:F->G, let sigma(phi):O_U->internalHom(F,G) [def-pur-sheaf-hom] be its global-section representative via unitHomEquiv and homObjSectionsEquiv. For every pair of arbitrary A-modules M,N there exists exactly one c:T(Hom_A(M,N))->internalHom(T(M),T(N)) satisfying gamma_Hom(h) followed by c = sigma(T(h)) for every h:M->N. This statement asserts neither naturality in M,N nor rank-one invertibility.

source.place: Lemma 26.7.1 (lemma-compare-constructions), mapping property for arbitrary target sheaves; Tag 01HV (4)-(5), principal-open localization and restriction.

proof.text: Use exists_affineHom_generator_extension, the existence component in the new module, with affineHomComparisonFunctor and affineHomComparisonUnitIso. Both chart-identification hypotheses are reflexivity. Unfolding only the generator and section definitions gives a witness c and exactly the required normalization.

For any other normalized d, the equations for c and d coincide on every generator. Cancel the inverse of the rank-one chart isomorphism. The composite chart functor is left adjoint (tilde is left adjoint and restriction along the scheme isomorphism is an equivalence). Apply injectivity of its adjunction homEquiv: naturality on the maps a |-> a*x, then evaluation at 1, proves the adjoint linear maps agree at every x. Hence d=c. This is the existing private hom_ext_of_elements proof.

from.place: Construction of the affine Hom coefficient comparison from its global generators, before naturality and finite-free invertibility.

lean.statement:
theorem existsUnique_affineHom_generator_extension {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (M N : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, U.1)) :
    ∃! c : (affineHomComparisonFunctor U).obj (ModuleCat.of Γ(Y, U.1) (M ⟶ N)) ⟶
        SheafOfModules.homObj (R := U.1.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
          ((affineHomComparisonFunctor U).obj M) ((affineHomComparisonFunctor U).obj N),
      ∀ h : M ⟶ N,
        affineHomGenerator U (ModuleCat.of Γ(Y, U.1) (M ⟶ N)) h ≫ c =
          affineHomSection (R := U.1.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
            ((affineHomComparisonFunctor U).obj M) ((affineHomComparisonFunctor U).obj N)
            ((affineHomComparisonFunctor U).map h)
